_readme: Dimensional limits for the exported parts, checked by blender/spec_gate.py.
Sizes are [min, max] in mm along the car axes: w = across (X), h = up (Y),
d = fore-aft (Z). Keys like 'y_min' bound one edge of the bounding box.
Facts only -- a JB74 is 3550 x 1645 x 1730 mm on a 2250 mm wheelbase, and
an aftermarket bar or step stays inside the body plus its flares. Entries
carry the source of the number they encode.

frontBumper_.note: no wider than the body (1645) plus a flare each side

sideStep_.note: sits inside the body width; length spans the door aperture

grille_.note: all grilles reuse the stock aperture

roofRack_.note: roof is 1290 between the gutters; trays overhang a little

snorkel_.note: airbox to roofline on the right A-pillar

rim_.note: built at 16 in (406.4 mm bead) plus the tyre bead lip; scaled per size in the page

ladder_jst.note: standard version, 270 mm inside the hoop (Shopee listing)

frontBumper_tube_heritage.note: KLC Traditional 74: straight tube, ends inboard of the flares

rearBumper_klc_heritage_rear.note: tube runs above the tail lamps and out past their outer edge (x 680)
